scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin-panel
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,blue" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix admin-panel"
scripts.start: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,blue" "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend" "npm run preview --prefix admin-panel"
